# Shrikanteshwar Reddy Pasham
Shrikanteshwar Reddy Pasham is a Hyderabad-based student-entrepreneur, Founder & CEO of Canies Academy™ and Chief Architect of Synergy Reddy Group™.

## Hero Section
Available for New Opportunities
Founder · Product Builder · Tech & Systems Strategist
Building scalable, tech-driven solutions across education, automation, and digital businesses. Founder of Canies Academy™ and Synergy Reddy Group™, based in Hyderabad, India.
"I build first, polish later."

## About Me
Bridging Engineering, Technology, and Business
I'm a civil engineering student at RGUKT Basar and a student-entrepreneur based in Hyderabad, Telangana. I work at the intersection of technology, systems, and business — building practical, scalable solutions rather than academic-only projects.

As Founder & CEO of Canies Academy™ and Co-Founder & Chief Architect of Synergy Reddy Group™, I lead operations, product thinking, and automation across multiple ventures. My work spans web systems, cloud-based automation, AI-assisted workflows, electronics, and early-stage product development.

- Execution First: I focus on breaking complex problems into deployable solutions using technology, data, and structured decision-making.
- Scalable Systems: I believe real impact comes from building systems that scale, not just learning tools or collecting certificates.
- Venture Design: Driven by curiosity and experimentation to create product-based businesses that solve real-world problems.

## Categorized Expertise
A holistic approach to technology development, from hardware systems to high-level strategic product decisions.

- Technology: Web apps & internal tools, Linux & cloud systems, Databases & deployment.
- Hardware & Emerging Tech: Robotics & AI fundamentals, Electronics & PCB design, IoT & automation.

## Professional History
- Canies Academy™ — Founder & CEO (2023–Present). Founded and scaled an edtech venture training school students in emerging tech. Built an industry-integrated talent pipeline. Designed digital learning architectures.
- Synergy Reddy Group™ — Co-Founder, CEO & Chief Architect (2023–Present). Founded Reddy Experts, worked with 5+ startups on automation, ran Tech Olympiad 2025 and TechSpark 2025. Building large-scale product-based ventures.
- Black Box — Director (2023–2024). Directed a campus-based smart snacks store with 5-minute delivery, impacting 5000+ students. Managed rapid food distribution logistics.
